summary: Aya Gold & Silver filed a 6-K furnishing a press release disclosing a term sheet with Sama Resources (TSXV: SME) to sell its Azegour copper-tungsten-molybdenum project in Morocco. Consideration is payable entirely in Sama common shares representing up to 19.11% of Sama's post-issuance shares outstanding; no cash price or premium was stated. Sama would acquire a newly formed Aya subsidiary holding the mining titles, with a regional IP license and one year of transitional support. Conditions include a definitive agreement and regulatory approvals; no advisor or board recommendation named. Watch definitive-agreement execution, approvals, and Aya's resulting Sama stake overhang.
